heading: Best Brunch in Vernon
title: Best Brunch & Breakfast in Vernon | Okanagan Roam
description: Where to brunch in Vernon: breakfast poutine, Filipino breakfasts, a patio at Predator Ridge, family cafés, vegan cinnamon rolls and scratch bakeries.
intro: Vernon does breakfast the friendly way. Most of the best mornings here happen in locally run diners where the owners know the regulars, with a few surprises mixed in: Filipino breakfast plates, chilaquiles, a café built for toddlers and a vegan café with its own cinnamon rolls.
These are the brunch and breakfast spots worth knowing, grouped by the kind of morning you're after.

items.name: Diner On Six
items.text: a cheerful diner with an upbeat atmosphere people look forward to. Two dishes carry the reputation, the breakfast poutine and the fluffy pancake combo, so add the second if you're extra hungry.

items.name: Rosalinda's
items.text: a family-run diner serving authentic Filipino breakfast dishes alongside Western classics. Reviewers say the Filipino plates are worth the drive from Kelowna, and the classics are covered well too.

items.name: Chill&Go Tacos
items.text: fresh chilaquiles and an owner who shares stories with guests rather than just taking orders. Order the chilaquiles and expect a story or two.

items.name: Eatology
items.text: a quaint order-at-the-counter diner that wins on quality rather than atmosphere. Order the corned beef hash and save room for a slice of home-baked pie.

items.name: Hot Spot on 6th Restaurant
items.text: a friendly, locally owned diner that cooks with local ingredients. The menu runs from eggs Benny to Salisbury steak skillets and pistachio lasagna, and there's a kids' menu.

items.name: Mug N Muffin
items.text: a mom-and-pop diner that Barb and Al have run for years, with its history on the walls. Expect homemade food, generous portions and fair prices.

items.name: Lunch Matters... Breakfast Too
items.text: an old-school diner with 60s style that hasn't cut corners to save money. The club sandwich is made with real turkey rather than processed deli meat.

sections.jump: With a view or a patio
sections.heading: With a view or a patio

items.name: RANGE restaurant, bar + patio
items.text: at Predator Ridge Resort, with an expansive patio and a stellar view. A shuttle runs from nearby Sparkling Hill, so you don't need your own car to get there.

items.name: The Rusty Putter (Spallumcheen Golf & Country Club)
items.text: the clubhouse breakfast spot at Spallumcheen Golf & Country Club, with a warm welcome. Pair your meal with a round on the championship course, before or after.

items.name: Cabana Bar + Kitchen
items.text: a stream runs right through the courtyard at this Vernon Lodge restaurant, so book a courtyard table near the water feature. The kitchen has a reputation for handling allergies thoughtfully; mention yours upfront.

items.name: East Hill Crossing Cafe
items.text: a cozy coffee shop and poutinerie with seating indoors and on the patio. Alongside coffee and pastries, the specialty is a Canadian poutine with bacon and maple syrup.

items.name: Cora
items.text: a bright, family-friendly breakfast and lunch spot with an extensive menu and big fruit-topped plates. Some guests have found the kids' fruit bowls small, so check before you order one.

items.name: Elodie's Playhouse Cafe
items.text: built around families, with four little playhouses, toys and open play for kids up to age five. The coffee bar pours real espresso and lattes for the grown-ups. Play is $16 for the first child and $14 for each sibling, with two adults free per paid child, and it's socks on, shoes off, grown-ups too.

items.name: Crepe Bistro
items.text: a food truck that has become a Sunday ritual at Sovereign Park. Order one savoury and one sweet crepe while the kids burn off energy in the park nearby.

items.name: White Spot Vernon
items.text: the classic B.C. family restaurant, on 32nd Street, serving everything from breakfast through dinner, with a patio for warmer days.

items.name: The Roxy Cafe - Vegan and Vegetarian Restaurant Cafe
items.text: it calls itself Vernon's favourite vegan café. Order at the counter, then settle into the bright, cheerful dining room with the butter chick'n or one of the vegan cinnamon rolls.

items.name: Two Donkeys Bakery
items.text: a greenery-filled scratch bakery best known for its sourdough, with gluten-free options you can trust.

items.name: Bean Scene Coffee House
items.text: three quirky levels, each with its own cozy nook, built for lingering rather than grab-and-go. The orange raspberry muffin is gluten-free.

sections.heading: Coffee, bakeries and a quick bite

items.name: Bean to Cup
items.text: the café locals default to, with strong coffee, homemade food and an unpretentious warmth. Dogs are always welcome on the front terrace.

items.name: Ratio Coffee & Pastry
items.text: a converted rail station with a vintage vibe and beans roasted in house. Eclairs are baked fresh on Tuesdays only, so that's the day to go.

items.name: Triumph Coffee
items.text: a cozy downtown roastery-café with an unusual pairing: curry tacos alongside the coffee. Claim one of the few sidewalk tables if the weather's nice.

items.name: Farmhouse Cafe
items.text: grows what it cooks, sourcing ingredients right on site for a simple menu. Order the soup and sandwich, and don't skip a scone, baked fresh.
